#### PR description:

Rather than have several specialization of the mergeProduct the difference shared the majority of the code, this change uses if constexpr to express just the parts that were different.

#### PR validation:

Code compiles and the unit tests in the package pass.

resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2483
title: Move MEtoEDM::mergeProduct to use if constexpr
